overview_description.description: Boltz, PBC is a public-benefit AI research company whose mission is to enable every scientist to reshape biology and create a healthier, more sustainable future. Its state-of-the-art AI models are used by leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies for biomolecular structure prediction, affinity estimation, and generative design across multiple modalities.
